info.title: Configuration service
info.description: The configuration service provides persistence for configuration with write schema validation.

get.description: Find configuration in a namespace, sorted by name, with the latest revision of each. Requires the configuration-admin role in the tenant, or the configured-service or export-service export-job role in the tenant or as a core user. Unlike the other read operations, the configuration-reader role is not sufficient, and core users with only the configuration-admin role are not allowed. Tenant users find the configuration of their tenant; core users find the configuration of the tenant given by `tenantId`, or core (platform) configuration without it.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Number of results to return in the page, e.g. the top N results. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor for retrieving additional pages. Use the `next` value returned by the previous call; other values are not supported.

parameters.name: includeActive
parameters.description: Flag indicating if the active revision of each configuration is included.

parameters.name: registeredId
parameters.description: Filter to configuration with a `registeredId` property of this value.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: JSON object of criteria. `nameContains` filters by name (case insensitive), and `createDateAfter` and `createDateBefore` filter by the created date of the latest revision. Any other string, number, or boolean property filters on the configuration property of the same name; strings are matched case insensitively as a partial match. Set `useOr` to true to match any rather than all configuration property criteria.

get.description: Retrieves configuration, with its latest and active revisions. Requires the configuration-reader, configuration-admin, configured-service, directory-service resource-resolver, or export-service export-job role, in the tenant or as a core user. Tenant users read the configuration of their tenant, or core (platform) configuration with `core`. Core users read the configuration of the tenant given by `tenantId`, or core configuration without it. Responds with the configuration and no `latest` if it has not been saved.

patch.description: Updates the latest configuration revision. Requires the configuration-admin or configured-service role, in the tenant or as a core user. Tenant users update the configuration of their tenant; core users update the configuration of the tenant given by `tenantId`, or core (platform) configuration without it. The resulting configuration is validated against the configuration definition schema, if there is one. Updates do not create a new revision; use the CREATE-REVISION operation to snapshot the latest revision.

post.description: Creates a new revision of configuration, or sets the active revision. Requires the configuration-admin role, in the tenant or as a core user; the configured-service role is not sufficient. Tenant users act on the configuration of their tenant; core users act on the configuration of the tenant given by `tenantId`, or core (platform) configuration without it.

200.description: Request completed successfully. CREATE-REVISION responds with the configuration and its new latest revision; SET-ACTIVE-REVISION responds with the active revision number.

400.description: Request is invalid, or the selected revision does not exist.

value.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): operation (body) - Invalid value
Specified revision 9 to set as active cannot be found.

delete.description: Deletes configuration and all its revisions. Requires the configuration-admin role, in the tenant or as a core user. Tenant users delete the configuration of their tenant; core users delete the configuration of the tenant given by `tenantId`, or core (platform) configuration without it. Responds with `deleted` false if there was nothing to delete.

get.description: Retrieves the active revision of configuration. Requires the same roles as retrieving configuration, and acts on the same tenant. Anonymous requests (without a bearer token) are allowed if the configuration definition has anonymousRead set, in which case the `tenant` query parameter identifies the tenant and requests are rate limited. Responds with an empty body if there is no active revision and orLatest is not set.

parameters.name: orLatest
parameters.description: Flag indicating if the latest revision should be returned if there is no active revision.

get.description: Retrieves the configuration of the latest revision. Requires the same roles as retrieving configuration, and acts on the same tenant; tenant users can read core (platform) configuration with `core`. Anonymous requests (without a bearer token) are allowed if the configuration definition has anonymousRead set, in which case the `tenant` query parameter identifies the tenant and requests are rate limited. Responds with an empty object if there is no configuration.

Retrieves the revisions of configuration, newest first. Requires the same roles as retrieving configuration, in the tenant or as a core user. Tenant users read the revisions of their tenant's configuration; core users read the revisions of the tenant given by `tenantId`, or of core (platform) configuration without it.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Number of revisions to return in a page. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor for retrieving additional pages. Use the `next` value returned by the previous call.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: JSON object of criteria. `revision` filters to one revision number. Any other property filters on the configuration property of the same name; strings are matched case insensitively as a partial match.

get.description: Retrieves the configuration of a specific revision. Requires the same roles as retrieving configuration, and acts on the same tenant as retrieving revisions.

example.errorMessage: revision with ID '9' could not be found.

ConfigurationAnonymousTenant.name: tenant
ConfigurationAnonymousTenant.description: URN of the tenant to read configuration for, for anonymous requests, since there is no token to determine the tenant from. Anonymous requests without it read core (platform) configuration. Ignored for authenticated requests.

ConfigurationCore.name: core
ConfigurationCore.description: Flag indicating if the core (platform) instead of tenant configuration should be retrieved. The flag is set when the parameter is present, regardless of its value. Tenant users with a reader role can read core configuration this way.

ConfigurationName.name: name
ConfigurationName.description: Name of the configuration. Letters, numbers, dashes, underscores, and spaces only.

ConfigurationNamespace.name: namespace
ConfigurationNamespace.description: Namespace of the configuration. Letters, numbers, dashes, underscores, and spaces only.

ConfigurationTenantId.name: tenantId
ConfigurationTenantId.description: URN of the tenant to act on. Only used for core (platform) users, and for anonymous requests where `tenant` is not set; tenant users always act on the tenant of their token. Core users who leave it out act on core (platform) configuration.

ConfigurationBadRequest.description: Request is invalid, for example a path or query parameter failed validation, the operation is not recognized, a tenant ID is not a valid URN, or the configuration does not match the configuration definition schema.

value.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): operation (body) - Invalid value

operation.summary: Operation is missing a required property

schema.summary: Configuration does not match the definition schema

value.errorMessage: Value not valid for configuration 'platform:event-service': /definitions must be object

ConfigurationForbidden.description: User does not have the role required for the operation.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 1234) not permitted to modify configuration.

ConfigurationTooManyRequests.description: Too many anonymous requests. Anonymous requests are limited to 200 per IP address in 5 minutes.

text/html.example: Too many requests, please try again later.

ConfigurationUnauthorized.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token, or the configuration does not allow anonymous access.

example.errorMessage: Anonymous access to configuration not allowed.
Anonymous access to configuration not allowed.

after.description: The cursor used to generate the current page. Don't use it as the `after` parameter of the next call, as it repeats the page just returned.

next.description: Cursor for requesting the next page. Not set when no more results are available.

CreateRevisionOperation.description: Creates a new latest revision with a copy of the configuration of the current latest revision.

DeleteOperation.description: Removes a property, specified as a path such as a.b, from the latest revision.

ReplaceOperation.description: Replaces the configuration of the latest revision.

revision.description: Revision number to set as active. The revision must exist.

UpdateOperation.description: Merges the update into the latest revision. Top level object properties are merged one level deep; other values are replaced.
